Removed offload config keys that offload 0.9.12 ignores -- they logged an `Ignoring unrecognized config key` warning on every run and were dead config:

- `stream_output = true` from all four `offload-modal*.toml` configs. offload 0.9.12 has no such option; removing it is behavior-neutral (it was already being ignored).

- The top-level `[offload] retry_count = 2` from `offload-modal-acceptance.toml` and `offload-modal-release.toml`. Retries are governed by the per-group `retry_count` (acceptance = 1, release = 4); offload does not recognize `retry_count` at the `[offload]` level, so the top-level key had no effect.

Centralized the offload version pin behind a composite CI action. The three offload CI jobs (`test-offload`, `test-offload-acceptance`, `test-minds-snapshot`) each duplicated the same "install Rust + cache + `cargo install offload@<version>`" block, so a version bump had to edit the pin in three CI spots plus the Dockerfile. Those blocks are now a single composite action, `.github/actions/setup-offload`, whose `version` input defaults to the pin -- so the CI-side version lives in one place. Added `test_offload_version_pinned_consistently` (`test_meta_ratchets.py`) asserting the action's pin matches `OFFLOAD_VERSION` in the mngr Dockerfile, so the orchestrator and in-sandbox binary can't silently drift.

Skip coverage tracing during offload's `pytest --collect-only` discovery. Every offload config now sets `discovery_args = "--no-cov"` (the snapshot config merges it with its existing `-c pyproject.toml` rootdir pin). Coverage tracing is pure overhead during discovery (no tests run) and roughly halves whole-monorepo collection time; offload exposes the discovery-only arg hook but, by its design, does not auto-inject discovery args (they stay explicit), so mngr sets `--no-cov` here. `test_offload_configs_suppress_per_batch_coverage_reports` now asserts every config carries `--no-cov` in `discovery_args`, and its stale "offload handles this, do not configure it" note is retired (the separate `.venv/bin/pytest` speedup did land upstream and stays out of config).
